stem:
The diagram shows a level balance scale. The left pan holds sealed tin $P$ and a $100\,\mathrm{g}$ weight. The right pan holds a $350\,\mathrm{g}$ weight.

Which claim correctly gives the mass of tin $P$?

teacher.key_rationale: Level pans mean P+100=350, so P=250 g. Equivalently remove 100 g from each pan and leave P against 250 g. 450 adds both pan loads, 350 ignores the 100 g, and 100 takes the companion weight as P.
teacher.figure_note: Added a level two-pan balance with tin P and 100 g on the left and 350 g on the right.
